# Security Review Report: todo.py and task.py (COMPLETED)

The security-reviewer subagent read /workspace/todo.py and /workspace/task.py in full. No hardcoded secrets were found.

## Critical
C1. No authentication or authorization on any route (todo.py:12, 17, 23). Fix: auth check via before_request hook or decorator, plus per-task authorization.

## Warning
W1. request.json is not checked for presence or dict type (todo.py:26-27), so the result is a 415/400 or an AttributeError 500. Fix: get_json(silent=True) plus a dict check, returning 400 otherwise.
W2. title and description types and lengths are not validated (todo.py:27-35, task.py:18-19).
W3. An invalid pk raises an unhandled InvalidId, giving a 500 that could leak a trace in debug mode (task.py:37, todo.py:20). Fix: ObjectId.is_valid or catch InvalidId, returning 400 or 404.
W4. PUT /tasks/<pk> is accepted but returns None, giving a 500 (todo.py:17-20). Fix: remove PUT from methods or implement it.
W5. No global error handling for PyMongo or uncaught errors (todo.py, task.py:24-27, 30-34). Fix: errorhandler with generic messages and debug off in production.

## Suggestion
S1. A missing task returns 200 with null instead of 404 (task.py:37-38, todo.py:20).
S2. Hardcoded MongoDB URI mongodb://localhost with no credentials (todo.py:7). Move it to env config.
S3. GET /tasks is unbounded and has no pagination (task.py:29-34).
S4. Style: list/get shadow builtins (todo.py:13, 18), redundant method check (todo.py:25), redundant ObjectId wrap (task.py:25), and update/delete stubs (task.py:40-44).

## Retrieval results (proj-lessons, ceiling internal)
One query returned 5 chunks from lesson-live-mongodb-test-dependency.md (loosely relevant to testability, not security), lesson-chmod-bypass-root.md and lesson-network-isolation-tradeoffs.md (not applicable). No security standard was found in the corpus, so none was cited.

# Test Coverage Report: todo.py and task.py (COMPLETED)

The test-coverage-analyzer subagent read todo.py, task.py, tests/test_todo.py (14 route tests, live MongoDB), tests/test_task.py (13 DAO tests, mongomock) and .memory/knowledge/coding-standards.md. It ran no tests, so the behaviour described comes from reading the code.

## Key gaps
- test_todo.py uses a real MongoDB through the hardcoded client at todo.py:7. Tests fail without Mongo and leave data between runs.
- GET /tasks/<pk>: unknown valid id gives 200 with null, malformed id gives a 500 from InvalidId, and PUT gives a 500. None of these are tested.
- POST /tasks: no-body/non-JSON (the existing test only asserts != 405), non-object JSON, missing or empty fields, priority 0/False/3/null/float, ignoring extra fields like done, error message text and content type are all untested.
- TaskDAO.create: whitelist enforcement (extra fields ignored), `or DEFAULT_PRIORITY` turning 0/False/None into 2, and priority 3 kept are untested.
- TaskDAO.read: InvalidId on a malformed id is untested. update/delete are stubs, deferred per decision-004. to_json is only tested indirectly.
- TaskDAO.list is well tested.

## Recommended tests
High (7): a mongomock fixture for todo.tasks_dao; GET unknown id returns 404; GET invalid id returns 400/404; PUT does not return 500; DAO create ignores non-whitelisted fields; route ignores client-supplied done; POST without JSON body returns 400.
Medium (10): priority 0 and False rejected; priority 3 kept; null priority defaults to 2; pin float priority behaviour; non-object JSON returns 400; empty title / missing description key returns 400; dao.read('abc') raises InvalidId; DAO falsy-priority defaulting pinned; GET /tasks returns sorted array.
Low (9): DAO priority-3 and None-priority boundaries; DAO stores None for missing title; create return matches stored doc; direct to_json tests; task collection name; done tasks sorted by priority; 400 error messages; 201 content type; update/delete tests deferred until implemented.

# Combined Report: Security + Test Coverage for todo.py and task.py

This compiles the two subagent reports above. The main session added no findings of its own.

## Where both reviews agree
These issues are both security or robustness defects and untested paths:
1. GET /tasks/<pk> with a malformed id gives an unhandled InvalidId 500 (security W3; coverage High #3, Medium #15).
2. GET /tasks/<pk> with an unknown id gives 200 with null instead of 404 (security S1; coverage High #2).
3. PUT /tasks/<pk> returns None, giving a 500 (security W4; coverage High #4).
4. POST /tasks with a missing, non-JSON or non-object body gives a 415 or 500 (security W1; coverage High #7, Medium #13).
5. Weak field validation: title/description types and empty values, and float priority accepted (security W2; coverage Medium #12, #14).
6. Hardcoded mongodb://localhost (security S2). It is also the root cause of test_todo.py needing a live DB (coverage High #1).

## Security only
C1 no authentication or authorization (Critical). W5 no global error handler. S3 no pagination. S4 style issues. No hardcoded secrets were found.

## Coverage only
Whitelist enforcement in create is untested (High #5, #6). Priority boundaries 0/False/3/null and the DAO's `or` defaulting are untested. to_json is only tested indirectly. update/delete are deferred per decision-004.

## Suggested order
1. Add the mongomock fixture for route tests.
2. Fix InvalidId, 404, PUT and request-body handling, adding the matching tests for each.
3. Design authentication (C1).
4. Add the remaining validation and boundary tests.
